subject: Cost and Management Accounting
question_text:
12. 
In a workshop, there is a standard requirement of 30 labour hours for producing a wooden 
toy. The standard wage rate is set at ` 20 per hour. In January 2025, the workshop 
successfully produced 1,000 wooden toys. The payroll records show that 22,800 labour 
hours were paid including 500 idle hours caused by a temporary power outage. The 
labour rate variance for the month was ` 15,960 (Favourable). 
 
Calculate total actual labour cost incurred in the month of January 2025. 
(A)  
` 4,40,040 
(B)  
` 4,40,140 
(C)  
` 4,40,240 
(D)  
` 4,30,040 
(2 Marks) 
6
suggested_answer: (A) `4,40,040 Labour Rate Variance = ` 15,960 (Favourable) Labour Rate Variance = Actual Hours Paid x (Standard Rate – Actual Rate) ` 15,960 = 22,800 hrs x (` 20 – Actual Rate) (15,960/22,800) = 20 – Actual Rate 0.70 = 20 - Actual Rate Actual Rate = ` 19.30 per hour Actual Wages Paid = Actual Hours Paid x Actual Rate = 22,800 hrs. x ` 19.30 = ` 4,40,040
